label: late original-phase positions (t>=7), favoring tokens i/v/m/l/3/h/b/2
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, and only at late positions: nothing before t=5, and 99% of activations are at orig_idx>=6 (90% of the mass is at orig_idx 7-8, where 18-29% of steps are active). So it fires mostly in L=8-9 sequences on the last one or two tokens before <DEL>. It never fires on the delimiter or during the copy phase. Position alone is necessary but imprecise (orig_idx>=7: P=0.22, R=0.84). Which token is input changes the rate: i, v, m, l, 3, h, b and 2 have a 2-3.6x lift. Prefix content also has weaker effects: a higher rate with first token y/r/g, more digits in the sequence, and first occurrences of a token. Restricting to the favored tokens gives dev F1 0.54 and mass recall 0.66. Top activations are at t=7-8 on tokens like m/v/i/3.
